rule: No backtest or forecast number in this pack is price-dependent; none is published.
Opening/closing price columns may exist as schema, but stay empty until a licensed, timestamped feed is attached; empty never means zero.
No settlement, ROI, CLV or payout figure may be published without both price rows (open AND close) and an official final.
If a price source appears later, it must carry: market id, timestamp with zone, source name, and an immutable row id, or it is rejected.
